summary: This is a routine Form 8-K filed by Barinthus Biotherapeutics plc reporting the results of its 2026 Annual General Meeting. The filing discloses the votes cast on director re-elections, reappointment of auditors, and authorization to set auditor remuneration. All ordinary resolutions were approved. No special-situation event—such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, tender offer, restructuring, or management change—is present. The disclosure is a standard item 5.07 submission of matters to a vote of security holders, with no actionable event or strategic shift. Accordingly, this filing does not trigger a special-situations classification.
